feature_contract.goal: Keep OutRun original main menu and car selector 4:3 full-height inside physical live-screen letterbox instead of vertically compressing or shrinking both native D3DX and custom sprite paths when game screen_scale is stale/small.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Centered 4:3 title/menu/selector game UI only. Exclude gameplay HUD, +TIME, GOAL, ESC, F11, vanilla/online modes, native input, FFB, SkyGlow, world stereo, R26_SAFE, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original OutRun title and vehicle selector native 4:3 sprite sources produce D3DX transformation matrices and textured custom sprite corners.
Native x86 hooks_uiscaling transforms D3DX matrices and independently maps custom SpriteNode textured vertices to the same physical menu aspect viewport.
R84 physical game native Draw and existing stereo host presentation consume these pixels without reclassifying shader or game-to-eye scope; only HMD can verify resulting binocular view.
subcomponents: Correct centered title/menu/selector full, partial and pivoted D3DX sprite matrix containment when stale game scale is smaller than physical output.
Correct separate original custom menu SpriteNode quad so same physical 4:3 fill scale and offsets reach the native DrawPrimitiveUP.
Add native smoke across ultrawide, portrait, invalid surface and protected unchanged non-menu/gameplay default.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original menu D3DX matrix and custom textured quads
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Centred 4:3 menu and vehicle selector source paths use the same physical containment and no unnecessary vertical inset at 21:9 or portrait.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Gameplay HUD, +TIME, GOAL, online/vanilla, missing surface and original small scale
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Default path keeps old bounded game scale and invalid outputs fail closed; game state and non-centred modes do not opt in.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 game Win32, host x64, package, Domain and source inspector
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Full exact SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact workflows must pass before build verified; HMD untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: User reported horizontally enlarged main menu still failing to fill intended screen height; original SUMO_FE and selector assets have 4:3 game-space producers.
diagnosis.root_cause: Source BuildPixelMap and BuildFrontEndAffineContain independently clamp menu 4:3 scale to min(game cached screen_scale, actual physical viewport contain). A smaller stale cached game scale produces a tiny inlaid menu instead of full-height contained 4:3.
source_trace: Game title/menu/selector native D3DX full, partial and pivot matrix scaling enters hooks_uiscaling.
Custom textured menu quad uses separate 4-corner projective source with BuildPixelMap inside draw_sprite_custom_matrix_mid.
Centered mode now opts both source routes into full physical 4:3 contain while keeping existing R84 eye host and game native draw ownership.
alternatives_rejected: Do not enlarge original gameplay HUD or F11, globally stretch 21:9 axes, retag GOAL/+/SkyGlow, or claim Quest3 HMD success from geometry code.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Native menu source geometry only; both eye draw ownership remains existing R84 path and no HMD frame has been observed.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Both independent front-end source paths select physical 4:3 contain scale with GameState title/menu/selector plus KeepCentered only.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Native smoke verifies wide, portrait, prior undersized game scale, invalid surfaces and default non-menu fallback.
